item.text:
Updated the page to fetch posts with `getPosts()` and render each post’s title and author in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx). The cached helper uses `"use cache"`, `cacheLife('hours')` for hourly revalidation, and `cacheTag('posts')` so the cache can be invalidated by tag.

Enabled `cacheComponents` in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts), as required for these caching APIs. I did not run tests or a build.
